gloss: merit pay; ability-based pay; performance-based salary

definitions.gloss: merit pay; ability-based pay; performance-based salary
definitions.explanation: A compensation system in which an employee's pay is determined by their skills, abilities, or performance rather than by seniority or a fixed scale.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{能力給|のうりょくきゅう}を{導入|どうにゅう}している。
examples.english: This company has introduced merit pay.

examples.japanese: {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}なら{若|わか}い{社員|しゃいん}にもチャンスがある。
examples.english: With merit pay, even young employees have a chance.

examples.japanese: {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}から{能力給|のうりょくきゅう}への{移行|いこう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: The shift from seniority-based pay to merit-based pay is progressing.

notes:
A compound of {能力|のうりょく} (ability, competence) and {給|きゅう} (pay, salary). Describes a pay system that rewards individual performance and skills rather than tenure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}を{導入|どうにゅう}する: to introduce merit pay
- {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}{制度|せいど}: merit pay system
- {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}に{移行|いこう}する: to transition to merit pay
- {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}と{年功給|ねんこうきゅう}: merit pay and seniority pay

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年功給|ねんこうきゅう}: seniority-based pay — the traditional Japanese system where pay increases with years of service
- {成果給|せいかきゅう}: results-based pay — pay based specifically on output or results; slightly different from {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}, which considers skills and abilities regardless of specific outcomes
- {歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}: commission-based pay — pay calculated as a percentage of sales or transactions

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, Japanese companies relied on {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ} (seniority-based promotion and pay). Since the 1990s, many companies have shifted toward {能力給|のうりょくきゅう} or {成果主義|せいかしゅぎ} (results-oriented management) to attract talent and improve competitiveness. This shift has been a major topic in Japanese business culture.
